description:
Export every artboard in the active document to a folder (duplicate + crop to artboardRect, then PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF).

Users often say: export all artboards, multi-screen PNG, 画板 çıktısı.

Use when: delivering one file per artboard. Long jobs use a 600s script timeout.
Do NOT use when: exporting the whole canvas once — use photoshop_export_as.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { exported[], failed[], folder } }.
Preconditions: document with at least one artboard. Side effects: writes files; does not modify the original.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool activates that document before running so a UI tab switch cannot retarget the edit.

name: photoshop_export_artboards
